{{Quote|Seeg, the Rodian, and I staged a fistfight in one of the larger clubs in the capital city. The little lizard missed a cue and broke my nose&hellip; I threw him over the bar, but it was an 'honest' accident. The stunt worked&mdash;when we were released from the local jail the next morning, Tefilous informed us that our popularity on Ord Dorlass had increased by six points.|Siro Simito, report on the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade|<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>}}
The [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Dorlass]] had a cosmopolitan '''capital city'''.<ref name="CSWE Dorlass">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord Dorlass}}</ref> It featured several [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclubs]] as well as a [[Prison/Legends|jail]]. During a [[Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade]] [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] race held during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Racer/Legends|racers]] [[Siro Simito]] and [[Seeg]] staged a fistfight in [[Unidentified nightclub|one]] of the [[City/Legends|city's]] nightclubs in order to boost their popularity.<ref name="CRO" />
